Method of Attack: cross-site scripting attacks exploiting improper validation of user-supplied input in web-based management interface
high-severity zero-day exploit with publicly available proof-of-concept exploit code
Discoverer: Pierre Vivegnis of the NATO Cyber Security Centre (NCSC)
Impacted Systems: Cisco Prime Collaboration Deployment (PCD) software versions 14 and earlier
Cisco IP phones running 7800 and 8800 Series firmware version 14.2 and earlier
Attack Vector: crafted link persuading user to click in web-based management interface
exploiting Cisco Discovery Protocol on affected IP phones supporting LLDP
